subject.title: fix: workflow sanity audit passes on main

question: Should the fallback GitHub App installation be required to hold `contents: read` so labeler configuration loading remains available when the primary App token cannot be minted?
rationale: This is an external App-installation permission and automation-availability choice; source review can show the request but cannot decide the repository’s acceptable fallback security boundary.

options.title: Approve the shared read scope
options.body: Confirm both App installations intentionally have repository content-read access and retain the two explicit permission requests.

options.title: Keep fallback least-privilege
options.body: Redesign the fallback path so it does not need repository-content reads, or remove it from configuration-loading duties.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared read scope
recommendation.body: Confirm both App installations intentionally have repository content-read access and retain the two explicit permission requests.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the permission rationale and the current-head workflow validation, making them the best evidenced contact to route the configuration question to; repository ownership could not be established from the supplied history.
